about.title: Personal, not anonymous.
about.intro: semanu makes digital solutions predictable and simple for SMEs. From 3D configurators to business software with automation and AI, you get one clear partner that grows with your business.
about.nameText: semanu comes from the Antwerp dialect, rooted in Flemish. It is an exclamation of admiration, a spontaneous wow when something truly impresses. That is exactly the reaction your website should spark in your visitors. We build modern, fast and mobile sites with content that sells, stays in mind and turns visitors into customers. All in one clear subscription without a large upfront investment.
about.missionText: Many small businesses need a good website without the technical burden. We take care of design, build, hosting, maintenance, security and SEO foundations, so you can focus on your business. Because we work with AI, we build faster and at a lower cost than traditional agencies and offer AI solutions like assistants and automations as part of our service.
about.founderText: semanu is led by Tom de Vree and is based in Antwerp. We work personally with SMEs and manufacturers across Europe. You talk directly to the person who builds your solution.
about.ctaTitle: Ready for a website that grows with you?

serviceUi.analysisText: Software platforms always start with a thorough business analysis. We map how standardised your flows and processes are and set the expectations and technical criteria upfront. The strength of these projects lies in the preparation.
